body:
Help is needed to identify this entity:
- 3 trips each time 1 drop of LSD
1st trip +0days
2nd +3months
3d trip: 7days after 2nd trip
In each one of my trips I saw the invisible entity besides the normal bending and colorchanging of the background objects walls etc. And on my final experience I saw it most strongly because I was at home at the time of the peak, the whole trip lasted 12h.
And now 1 week later I still see this entity it's invisible but when it moves it induces hallucinations and I can spot it moving around sometimes. I also link it with unpleasant audio hallucinations and shaking (vibrating) of the glass on the windows. It also seems that it is trying to communicate but after all it is smarter than me because its some sort of unknown energy entity that exists in this dimension we see when a person takes acid. Honestly I am scared of this entity because it tried to communicate and also its inducing part of the visual distortions.
Seeking information help me to get it to go away.
I think these entities are real and the fact that acid makes me come in contact with them means it really does unlock your brain. We need to do research on these types of energy (the LSD entities, because I saw more than one).
The trip is quite real its just a different dimension that I get to see and experience.
